In this video, we take you through Girona’s ancient Roman past, its beautifully preserved medieval streets, and the iconic locations featured in Season 6 of Game of Thrones. From walking along 2,000-year-old Roman walls to exploring the Gothic Girona Cathedral (the Great Sept of Baelor!) and discovering the maze-like Jewish Quarter, Girona feels like a living time capsule. 📍 Location: Girona, Catalonia, Spain 🧭 GPS Coordinates: 41.9831° N, 2.8249° E ✅ Perfect for a day trip from Barcelona ✅ Featured in Game of Thrones as Braavos & King’s Landing ✅ Rich in Catalan history, Roman ruins, and medieval architecture 👉 Hit Subscribe for more travel guides through Spain, Catalonia, and beyond! …...more ...more Show less How this was madeAuto-dubbedAudio tracks for some languages were automatically generated.
